text:
The island of memory will burst.

Life will be only an act of candor.

Prison

for the days without return.

Tomorrow

the monsters of the ship will destroy the beach

over the wind of mystery.

Tomorrow

the unknown letter will find the hands of the soul.

translation.title: The Island of Memory Will Burst...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the future tense as a sequence of visionary ruptures.
